errors.error_description: Inside a clocked always_ff block, a blocking assignment is used (shadow_valid = val_r) alongside non-blocking assignments, creating a potential race due to mixed assignment types.
A bitwise AND operator '&' is used in an if condition (if (en & ready_i)) where a logical AND '&&' should be used, risking unintended truth-table behavior with X/Z values.
A combinational block assigns hold_last only in one branch without a default or else path, inferring a latch during synthesis.
